segments.oily: Reports from reviewers with oily or combination-oily skin are mixed: several say it does not break them out and even improves their skin (smoother, fewer blackheads, glowing), but multiple others, including one with otherwise non-breakout-prone oily skin, report it leaves a greasy film or triggers whiteheads, and other reviewers explicitly warn it may be too much for oily skin.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin are consistently positive, describing it as deeply hydrating, gentle and a holy grail for very dry or flaky skin, without stripping or tightness.
segments.combination: Reviewers with combination skin have mixed results: some report no irritation and effective makeup removal, but one with combination skin says it left too much residue and didn't feel suitable for her skin type.
segments.sensitive: Most reviewers with sensitive skin, including acne-prone sensitive and rosacea-prone skin, report no irritation or breakouts and a calming, hydrating effect, though one reviewer developed small bumps she suspected was an allergic reaction.
segments.mature: One reviewer in her early 50s with dry skin reports her skin feels butter-soft after use.

concerns.blemishes: Reports are split: many reviewers, including several who are acne-prone, say it does not cause breakouts and even helps clear their skin over weeks of use, but multiple others report it broke them out, clogged their pores or irritated their skin soon after starting.
concerns.oiliness: Several reviewers, particularly with oily skin, report the cleanser leaves a greasy film that doesn't rinse off and doesn't help with oiliness or pores; others, including one with self-described oily skin, find it does not break them out and even reduces oil on the T-zone over time, though multiple reviewers caution it may be too rich for oily skin.
concerns.dehydration: The large majority of reviewers, especially those with dry skin, report strong hydration without tightness or stripping; even reviewers who dislike the residue generally describe the skin underneath as soft and never dried out.
concerns.redness: One reviewer reports the cleanser helped with redness and dry skin in winter.

aspects.libelle: Transforms from gel to milky texture with water
Doesn't foam or lather like typical cleansers
Snap-cap lid leaks and wastes product
Doesn't fully remove waterproof mascara or eye makeup
Scent can turn unpleasant or linger on skin
Works well as the first step in a double cleanse
A little product goes a long way

extraits.texte: I really needed a cleanser bc the one I had I had run out and I love Tula cleanser but I wanted to try something new and so I thought this one would be fine bc I like jelly cleansers and I've washed my face with this cleanser 3 times and every time I finished rinsing it off my face felt oily and sticky and I would try to wash that of but it just wouldn'. This product feels like vaseline same texture and when you put it on the skin same thing I don't recommend unless you like a thick cleanser that will give you trouble to take it off then go for it but I really didn't like it. I'll be buying my Tula product forever now.
Smell is super plastic-y and it made my face break out so bad after use. It also feels like it clogged my pores and didn't clean my face at all.

This is a jelly to milk cleanser, and I love the texture and feel on my skin. It didn't cause me any breakouts or sensitivity and I have VERY acne prone sensitive skin. The only problem is, it doesn't actually cleanse my skin. It's almost like rubbing in an oil. I never use water proof mascara, and all this cleanser did was move around my mascara and made it stick to my skin. I had to use a different cleanser to actually get it off my cheeks. I honestly don't know if it's removing my SPF either. Just in case I've been double cleansing with it, but I don't think I will repurchase.

extraits.titre: Interesting but totally worth the buy
extraits.texte: So I recently purchased this after my Glossier Milky Jelly Cleanser ran out… I wanted a nice eco-friendly, clean, and transparent brand and product. Which was not Glossier, so I tried Map Hippie Jelly cleanser instead hoping it would be similar. I would say it's equivalent if not better aside from a few things. 1) It does leave a kind of "film" right after you wash. I washed my face in the shower with a Foreo brush and I could feel it when I stepped out. BUT After I let my face dry my face absorbed all of it and it felt so clean and soft. glossier tended to dry my face out… so that's a positive but a little different. 2) It does have the honey consistency but it's a little thinner than honey. Glossier was a little more runny but this one was pretty good. Lastly it helped quite a bit with redness and dry skin in winter. Looking forward to seeing how it works out for me. I have combo skin and I'm acne prone.

I picked this up since I was out of my gentle facial cleanser (it was on sale). I have dry skin, so I found this ridiculously hydrating. Some people say it leaves a film (the ppl with oily skin), but it made my skin feel firmly hydrated, which was a first for me, since other hydrating cleansers never have left me feeling THIS hydrated. it comes out as a thicc jelly, which turns liquidy milky when mixed with water. it won't foam, but just wash for 30 seconds like the directions say, and it does its magic. Washing it off was odd, because there wasn't much to wash away since your skin absorbs quite a bit of it, and there is no lather to wash away either. I love that there are some skincare actives that are in the formula, that I don't have in my basic routine. So it makes it even better for me! (resveratrol is so under rated). I used to adore the daily moisturizer, but ditched it last year because of how similar my serum was to it, and the serum was cheaper. I didn't realize how much I missed mad hippie tho! 💖 The jelly is better than the cream cleanser, that just felt like lotion for your face. This one feels like it actually cleans my skin! Worth a shot for the dry skin gang ✨
I have super sensitive, dry skin. Every single recommendation for sensitive skin broke me out so bad. After a day of using this my skin is glowing, hydrated and clear. 10/10

extraits.titre: Excellent product - just not right for me
extraits.texte: This is a beautiful gel to milk texture that genuinely does melt makeup, oil, and gunk away! I have the kind of oily skin that doesn't break out, but is very self hydrating and this formulas was too oily for me. I had little white heads the second morning. That never happens! I liked the texture, the smell, and how easily it took off even mascara. My skin didn't feel fully clean after, even though I know that it cleaned. Again, I think it's just a little too awesome for my well oiled skin. I contacted customer service and Amy quickly responded that I might want to try the cream cleanser instead and she sent me a sample that is on its way! And I can return the Jelly Cleanser! Amazing! So impressed. I'm using the Vit. A and C serums and the hydrating sunscreen and I L O V E them!
